facts.text: Teams commonly confuse the operating domain with the scenario catalog.
facts.quote: The two layers that most teams confuse are the operating domain and the scenario catalog

facts.text: Published evidence treats the operating domain, the scenario catalog and parameterised scenario families as three distinct objects that solve three different problems.
facts.quote: the published evidence treats them, together with parameterised scenario families, as three different objects that solve three different problems

facts.text: The operating domain, scenario catalog and parameterised scenario families should be used together to structure the test space.
